item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
Hmmm, anomalous Forrest Gump…hmmm

An upper-tier "type green" but with mental deficiencies. So things tend to go right for him in nigh-on-unbelievable ways, but he's too unaware to even realize that's unusual; much less learn to control his abilities.

Maybe a guy who has found a loophole in the time-space-velocity mathematics. Now he knows how to exploit even moderate acceleration, jogging for instance, and turn it into relativistic time travel effects. He can go back and be part of all histories great events, or even fix the mistakes he's made so that he doesn't lose the love of his life. Downside is that the human mind wasn't meant to deal with that sort of temporal shenanigans, and every change he makes to the timeline further impairs his general cognitive functions.
